ownerDecision: October4: emailed recovery links, using operator-provided POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN, POSTMARK_FROM_EMAIL and POSTMARK_MESSAGE_STREAM. ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAILS must not receive player recovery links. No token values were read or printed and no real messages sent.
changes: Separate verified recovery mailbox from unverified registration email. Require current-password proof plus a30-minute single-use confirmation link to establish/replace the mailbox. Password-reset links last15 minutes; only SHA256 digests are stored, bound to exact account, observed password hash and verified address. Durable per-account one-minute issuance cooldown preserves the current link on rejected resends. Conditional updates consume challenges; ordinary password changes invalidate outstanding challenges. Preserve all unrelated account/character/role/value data. Postmark provider uses fixed HTTPS/email endpoint, eight-second timeout, no redirects, no administrator copies and disabled open/link tracking; parse provider acknowledgement without exposing diagnostics.

checks.provider: Actual local TLS HTTP requests with synthetic credentials verify Postmark headers/body/recipient/stream/no tracking, accepted acknowledgement, nonzero/missing code, missing message ID, HTTP failure, malformed/trailing JSON and redirect refusal. Invalid/injected settings and recipient lists refuse; trusted HTTPS fragment links preserve reserved account characters. No Postmark network call or inbox-delivery claim.
checks.mongoScope: Mongo7 standalone, one CPU/512MiB, fresh synthetic collections. Unverified and unknown accounts give no recipient or mutation. Wrong password/account/token, exact-expiry and consumed links fail. Issuance cooldown keeps the prior link. Eight concurrent resets yield exactly one winner; winning bcrypt password authenticates, old password fails. Legacy metadata, roles, inventory, Gold12345 and EP100 stay exact. A pending new address does not replace verified recovery; subsequent ordinary password change invalidates both pending link families.
